title: DeviceKey
description: Device key descriptor returned from GET /api/devices/{imei}/keys. The raw key (`key_hex`) is intentionally absent — it is returned only in the POST create response.

key_id.description: Stable identifier for the key, opaque to clients

tenant_id.description: Tenant scope (populated by API; not a key property)

key_hex_first_8.description: First 8 hex chars of the raw key — safe-to-log identifier per Constitution Article XIV
